summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on investigating slow performance, particularly within the inventory section of the platform. Initial concerns about logging were addressed, with one participant noting that logs showed queries related to route analysis might have been the cause, but the issue was no longer present.

Testing revealed that the inventory feature performed surprisingly well even when accessed under administrator privileges, contrary to initial expectations. However, it was noted that clicking sorting options on the inventory table still causes slowdowns in some instances.

Several bugs were identified or discussed: a field type issue related to Sasha's requests (which will receive a hotfix), and an older bug concerning Combined campaigns.
decisions: A hotfix is planned for the field type issue observed during analysis.
action_items: Someone needs to investigate the persistent slowdown when sorting the inventory table.
